ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 10% high-intensity pixels (white/light gray) scattered against a 90% low-intensity (black) base across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly low-intensity black ground with contiguous high-intensity white circular rings (3-20 pixel radii) and fine linear white streaks distributed non-uniformly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with a wide aperture, approximately 115 degrees, with a shallow bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels along the entire boundary from the median notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curves extending laterally, exhibiting a steep upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white rings (cookie-cutter shark scars) clustered in the central and lateral regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; a prominent horizontal mark is visible on the mid-left lobe, and several diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white circular ring scarring and linear rake marks across the surface; a distinct white-textured calcification or barnacle cluster is present on the superior-most edge of the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-intensity white cluster on the extreme outer left tip that disrupts the dark pigmentation and smooth contour.
